{{Quote|I'm so happy.|Kerlay Utanks|<ref name="HNN" />}}
'''Kerlay Utanks''' was an individual who operated a kitchen appliance store in the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Fwillsving]]'s [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], [[Svitalos]],<ref name="HNN" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|47|sports/13314_1.html|Coruscant Eliminated in Galactic Cup Opening Round}} takes place on the date 13:3:14, which corresponds to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] according to the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], Fwillsving's [[Limmie/Legends|limmie]] [[Team Fwillsving|team]] triumphed over the planet of [[Kubindi/Legends|Kubindi's]] [[Team Kubindi|team]] with a single point in the opening round of the [[Galactic Cup of Limmie]]. This victory inspired a riot that ransacked Svitalos. One of the four million celebrants expressing their jubilation by looting, vandalizing, and partying in the streets, Utanks marked the occasion by detonating a number of [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]] in his own store. When asked for comment by a [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] reporter, Utanks only reaffirmed his euphoric sensibilities. The event was reported on HoloNet News on 13:3:14 [[Great ReSynchronization|GrS]].<ref name="HNN" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kerlay Utanks was mentioned in "Coruscant Eliminated in Galactic Cup Opening Round," an article<ref name="HNN" /> written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Paul Ens]].<ref name="credits">{{HoloNetNewsWeb||credits.html|Credits}}</ref> and published in ''[[HoloNet News Vol. 531 47]]'' on the [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News website]]<ref name="HNN" /> on [[March 14]], [[2002]].<ref name="HNN47 date">{{JCFCite|url=posts/6042498|board=Literature|thread=The Official HoloNetNews Discussion Thread|user=IAmTheDarkSide|date=2002-03-14|time=5:40 PM|archivedate=20200305125429}}</ref>
